name: Do not let websites access the language list
description: Turns off 'Let websites show me locally relevant content by accessing my language list' (Settings > Privacy & security > General) by setting HttpAcceptLanguageOptOut = 1 (REG_DWORD) in HKCU\Control Panel\International\User Profile. This is the same per-user preference the Settings toggle controls.
rationale: Keeps the full list of the user's Windows languages from being offered to websites, which reduces information available for tracking and fingerprinting.
effects: Windows does not let websites access the user's language list to show locally relevant content.
sideEffects: Websites that relied on the Windows language list may not select a matching language automatically; browsers keep using their own language settings.
notes: Windows default: the value does not exist and the setting is on.
Per-user preference; no Administrator rights are needed and the user can change it back in Settings at any time.

references.title: Microsoft Learn - Manage connections from Windows operating system components to Microsoft services, 18.1 General (HttpAcceptLanguageOptOut)
